acquisition method: The Q-Exactive was operated in a data-dependent acquisition mode to automatically switch between full MS scan and MS/MS acquisition.
cleavage agent: performing an on-bead digest using Smart trypsin (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
collision energy: fragmented in the HCD collision cell (normalized collision energy of 28%).
enrichment method: After the immunoprecipitation, beads were subjected to two additional washes before performing an on-bead digest using Smart trypsin (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
fragmentation method: fragmented in the HCD collision cell (normalized collision energy of 28%).
instrument: coupled to a Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
labeling: LC-MS/MS raw files were label-free quantified using the Progenesis QI for proteomics software (v4. Non-linear dynamics, Waters).
mass analyzer: MS/MS data were obtained in the Orbitrap at a resolution of 17,500 with a maximum acquisition time of 128 ms, an AGC target of 1 × 105, and a dynamic exclusion of 27 s.
precursor tolerance: The data were searched against the Human SwissProt database using a peptide mass tolerance of 10 parts per million, an MS/MS mass tolerance of 0.05, selecting trypsin as an enzyme (1 missed cleavage allowed), and oxidation of methionine, deamidation of NQ, phosphorylation of ST and acetylation of K, as variable modifications.
fragment tolerance: The data were searched against the Human SwissProt database using a peptide mass tolerance of 10 parts per million, an MS/MS mass tolerance of 0.05, selecting trypsin as an enzyme (1 missed cleavage allowed), and oxidation of methionine, deamidation of NQ, phosphorylation of ST and acetylation of K, as variable modifications.
ptm: oxidation of methionine (variable); deamidation of NQ (variable); phosphorylation of ST (variable); acetylation of K (variable)
